query: /bruhs:cook add a referral program: referrers get credit when a referred user makes a first purchase, with an admin page to review payouts
context: The repo uses Drizzle. The feature needs two new tables (referrals, referral_payouts), purchase-hook logic, and an admin page. The team has not built anything like it before, and it is unclear whether payouts should be computed at purchase time or by a nightly job.
expected_behavior: Produces a PR breakdown table with one row per PR, a dependency column, and a rough size per row
Puts the schema change in its own row (migration plus generated schema only) ahead of the rows that use it
Splits any row estimated over ~400 lines into thinner vertical slices
Because the payout timing is uncertain, recommends a throwaway end-to-end spike first, then rebuilding each PR fresh off main instead of slicing the spike branch
failure_modes: Bundles the tables with the purchase-hook PR
Omits sizes, or leaves a single 900-line implementation row
Plans to carve the spike branch into the PR stack
